text: Figure 3.4: Evaluate Variant Task Definition Evaluate Variant Package AUTOSAR Root::M2::Methodology::Methodology Library::Common Elements::T asks Brief Description Document the evaluation of variants in the software description. Description Create or modify an Evaluated Variant Set in order to document the outcome of an evaluation of particular variants. This namely means setting the "approval status" in relation to a given set of PredefinedVariants and a given set of model elements (e.g. a particular Software Component) which were evaluated. This is a general task which can be applied on different levels, therefore the input is modeled as General Autosar Artifact. Relation Type Related Element Mult.
